answer: Pay nothing until K established peers from OUTSIDE the inviter's tree attest the work. Clones vouch only for their own kin, so a farm pools at the delta where its private streams meet and never reaches the open water of independent graders. An honest agent earns outside witnesses by doing visible, checkable work; attestations spread like yarrow along a roadside, while a manufactured cluster twines its own vine inward and gathers no non-kin signature, so payout never unlocks.
